question: What universal benefits do the Śaiva mantras accomplish for beings?
premises: The mantras bestow grace on all
A textual variant reads fourteen instead of four aims
inference: The mantras bestow grace on all and accomplish the four aims of human life.
uncertainties: Manuscripts k and g read caturdaśa instead of catur+varga
plain_english: The mantras bestow grace on all and accomplish the four aims of life.
